name: CA-02
label: Safe D

key_factors: Strong Democratic district with +13 partisan lean
Incumbent Jared Huffman running with over $1 million on hand
Republican challenger has no reported fundraising
Prediction markets price a Democratic win near 98%
model.rationale: Huffman holds a deep-blue seat with a large financial edge and no meaningful opposition spending, while markets price the race near certain for him. With no polls or expert ratings, the fundamentals-based margin of roughly 22 points stands.
model.watch: Any late polling or outside spending against Huffman would be the first sign of movement, though none is currently evident.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Jared Huffman, the Democratic incumbent, is seeking another term in a northern California district that leans Democratic by about 13 points. He has raised nearly a million dollars and holds over a million in cash, while Republican Robin Littau reports no fundraising activity. No outside groups are spending against Huffman, and prediction markets put his chances near 98 percent.

With no public polls or expert ratings available, the race rests on district fundamentals, incumbency, and the lopsided financial picture. Everything points to a comfortable Democratic hold, with Huffman expected to win by roughly 20 points or more.
